import re

MAX_INPUT_LENGTH = 1024

def process_user_input(input_data: str) -> str:
    if len(input_data) > MAX_INPUT_LENGTH:
        raise ValueError('Input data is too long. It exceeds the maximum allowed length of 1024 characters.')
    cleaned_data = re.sub(r'<[^>]*>', '', input_data)
    return cleaned_data
